review.official:
Rangers serves on
Rhodes Island
Op Reserve Team A4
. A longtime veteran, he has traveled to many different places prior to serving in Rhodes Island's reserves. An expert archer, he still retains the characteristic agility and vigor of the
Savras
despite his advanced age.

files.description:
Radiological scan showed clear outlines of internal organs, with no visiable abnormalities. Originium Particle Test of the circulatory system indicates no Oripathy. The subject is confirmed uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Rangers shows no signs of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Operator Rangers seldom visits regions affected by Oripathy.
A master of camouflage and utilizing the environment to his advantage, Rangers favors pre-emptive strikes using the element of surprise over waiting for his prey.

Rangers is, without doubt, an excellent storyteller whose head is filled with fantastic tales and a desire to share them with others. After each morning class, many younger Operators offer 'Grandpa Rangers' a glass of water and beg him to regale them.

Unlike that of most Savras, Rangers's skin provides no natural camouflage at all. But he is also more confident and more open to communication than most of his kin. Whether that is a blessing or a curse is strictly up to him to decide.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I greatly admire your genius. It's my honor to be your guard.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: A man of my experience can tell you'll be a great leader one day, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I have an unusual skin tone, you say? Hah. Just a souvenir from back when I snuck into a biolab, and... Please, I'm joking around.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I need to wear this scarf, even when I sleep, or else my neck will get cold.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: This face of mine might be a little too exotic for your typical townsfolk. Heh, I tend to draw a curious crowd when I wander.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm surprised how polite you are to this old man! Not many besides Durin ask after my health.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: When I go barefoot, I can sense enemies through their vibrations on the ground.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmm... Snoring is a bad habit. The other rangers will hear you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Rangers, the Sniper. Call whenever you need me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Not bad.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: My turn, is it?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Good. Let me show you what an old man can do.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's get going.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Prey spotted. Commence operation.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm waiting for orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What are your orders?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Alright.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Found you!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Taste my arrow!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Challenge after challenge. Exactly what we wanted. Right, Noir Corne?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: What a satisfying battle!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A few of them got through. I'd call that decent.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Oh no, I'm out of breath...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: If you need anything, just say the word.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Urgh! Please, leave my tail be...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You like me that much, huh? Weird taste, I gotta say.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, it's been three hours, and the kiddos still clamoring for more of my stories. Talk to them, will ya...? The New Year always makes the young'uns so astonishingly lively. I can't compete with that…

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, how can I help you?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I'm kinda too old to follow what you young'uns may want. But here's a little something I like. This scarf's made out of my favorite material, lightweight but warm. It will keep you cozy when it's cold, Doctor. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Retirement? Too soon for that. Not while I still eat five buns for breakfast. Once my appetite declines, then—and only then, will I find some place to bask in the sun. But for now, don't you worry.
